e.title: Smith-Wilson (Python)
e.summary: Smith-Wilson 算法 Python 实现（OSM/Richman）：EIOPA 无风险利率曲线外推标准方法
e.body: Smith-Wilson 算法是 EIOPA 规定的 Solvency II 无风险利率曲线外推标准方法（把市场利率平滑外推到远期终值利率 UFR）。本仓库是 Ronald Richman（OSM）的 Python 实现。对 RIAA：Solvency II 折现率曲线构造的核心算法（与 [[solvency2rfr]] 的 EIOPA 数据配套——一个拉数据，一个外推）。关联 [[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（NSS 拟合）、[[yieldcurves]]（R 曲线工具）、[[esg]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：OSM（Ronald Richman）Smith-Wilson 算法 Python 实现（EIOPA RFR 外推）
e.summary_en: Python implementation of the Smith-Wilson algorithm (OSM/Richman): the EIOPA standard method for risk-free-curve extrapolation
e.summary_hk: Smith-Wilson 算法 Python 實現（OSM/Richman）：EIOPA 無風險利率曲線外推標準方法
e.body_en: The Smith-Wilson algorithm is the EIOPA-standard method for extrapolating Solvency II risk-free curves (smoothing market rates into a long-term ultimate forward rate UFR). This repo is Ronald Richman's (OSM) Python implementation. For RIAA: the core algorithm for Solvency II discount-curve construction (paired with [[solvency2rfr]]'s EIOPA data — one pulls the data, one extrapolates). Related: [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] (NSS fitting), [[yieldcurves]] (R curve tools), [[esg]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: Smith-Wilson 算法是 EIOPA 規定的 Solvency II 無風險利率曲線外推標準方法（把市場利率平滑外推到遠期終值利率 UFR）。本倉庫是 Ronald Richman（OSM）的 Python 實現。對 RIAA：Solvency II 折現率曲線構造的核心算法（與 [[solvency2rfr]] 的 EIOPA 數據配套——一個拉數據，一個外推）。關聯 [[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（NSS 擬合）、[[yieldcurves]]（R 曲線工具）、[[esg]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
